title: Twin Plateaus
concept: High team home plateaus with several deliberate ramps into contested lowlands.
difference_from_base: Promotes the Twin Plateaus example into a scalable, seeded template with protected ramps, configurable approach count and general resource controls.
intended_players: 1v1 or two teams up to 4v4; two starting pads per team.
routes: Two to four planned ramps per side connect the home heights and shared lowland; ramp corridors are reserved from resource/reclaim placement.
economy: Procedural mirrored economy and geothermal sites, with three protected opening spots per side on the home plateau.
known_weaknesses: Advanced very high or deep plateaus may leave little lowland or overlapping approaches.
